cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Approve the museum's invisible landing. I trained you to trust your judgment; it's time your signature did some work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've allowed enough confidence for twenty visitors. You used to need a railing before you'd trust a calculation. You're past that now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign under 'load-bearing'. A steady signature, like we practised. Your certainty will hold the inspectors as well; then we can cancel the scaffolding.
